import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Reading the diagrams manifest next, then I'll restructure and publish the report.

Now inserting the manifest fence byte-for-byte from the audited manifest read, and verifying the lead's own figure is byte-identical.

Links and anchors resolve. Now a word-level diff against the lead's report to confirm only the intended edits changed.

Diff shows only the intended edits: heading renumbering removed, §-refs turned into heading links, intro moved into Sources, the query/infographic/figure added. Registering the snapshot.

I published the lead's consolidated report as `202611/property_card_cabinets/property_card_cabinets.md` in the research repo and registered it as `research:202611/property_card_cabinets/property_card_cabinets.md` (`file:explicit:1199e0b47947681f5e6fcdf4`). The commit is declared and the host makes it after this turn.

**Structure:**
- **Opening order:** the file opens with the title, the research query, the infographic (`property_card_cabinets_infographic.png`, present beside the report), then `## Bottom line`, which holds the lead's Verdict.
- **Sections:** the remaining sections stay in the lead's order with their numbers removed. Recommended solution is the last section before Sources, as the request asked.
- **Intro paragraph:** the lead's opening "Consolidated report · 2026-11-26" paragraph moved to the top of Sources. That was the only place it could go once the opening order was fixed.
- **Section references:** the lead's own references like "§1" and "§4.5" would no longer match the PDF's automatic section numbers. I turned them into links to the matching headings. References to sections inside the swarm drafts (e.g. "cdx §5C") are left as they were.
- **Heading renames:** some headings contained commas or code and are used as link targets, so I reworded them:
  - "The `_` keymap" became "The underscore keymap".
  - "Requirement adjustments, explicitly called out" became "Requirement adjustments explicitly called out".
  - "Disagreements between the reports, resolved" became "Resolved disagreements between the reports".
  - "Parallel delivery with qi, qj, qm, qp" became "Parallel delivery with the four in-progress epics".
  - The glossary section's "(at go-live, via `/sase_memory_write`)" moved out of its heading into its first line.
- **Inline links:** I added a few, mainly from the bottom line to the unanimous findings, the requirement adjustments, parallel delivery, and the recommended solution.

**Checks:**
- **Content:** a word-level diff against the lead's report shows only the edits listed above. Every claim, table cell, number, the draft glossary entry and the open questions are intact. The lead's Figure 1 Mermaid diagram is byte-identical.
- **Links:** the lead's report has no external URLs, so nothing needed a web check and no links were unrepairable. All 10 links to the swarm drafts and the infographic link point to files that exist. Every in-document link matches a heading or figure anchor in pandoc's output.
- **Mermaid count:** the file has 2 Mermaid diagrams, the lead's 1 plus 1 accepted from the image agent.

**Diagrams** (manifest status `ready`, its source matches the lead's report, 1 proposed):
- **Accepted:** `live-preview-source-visibility`, anchored as `figure-live-preview-source-visibility`. Its anchor text is in the Live Preview bullet of "Absorption: hiding the stored sections", so it sits after that whole list. A one-sentence paragraph just above it links to it.
- **Omitted:** none.

The image agent also registered grk's three PNGs (`__grk_parallel`, `__grk_stack`, `__grk_underscore`). I didn't embed them because the lead's report doesn't. Its Sources section already notes that grk's figures ship alongside the report.
